p-2101.author: praman
p-2101.text: Reminder for the new year: if your program's output depends on the iteration order of a hash map, your program has a bug and the hash map is fine.

p-2102.author: alice
p-2102.text: Notes on deterministic time, for anyone who has ever written sleep(100) in a test: http://alicechen.dev/posts/deterministic-time

p-2103.author: quarks
p-2103.text: Every replay debugger demo is beautiful and every replay debugger in production is a shell script that greps a log. Prove me wrong.

p-2104.author: alice
p-2104.text: We can prove you wrong in about four minutes, but you have to let us record the run first.

p-2105.author: northstar
p-2105.text: Twelve minutes of elevated API latency this morning, now resolved. Timeline: http://status.northstar.example/

p-2106.author: bmartinez
p-2106.text: A test that passes on every machine you own and fails on exactly one CI runner is not flaky. It is correct, and you are the flaky one. Write-up: http://bmartinez.net/posts/hash-order-bit-me

p-2107.author: praman
p-2107.text: This is the Stack Overflow question I answered in February, and the answer is still the same: sort the frontier. http://stackoverflow.com/questions/t-4411

p-2108.author: alice
p-2108.text: Atlas 1.0 is out. The walkthrough is on YouTube because that is where the video is, not because I have opinions about it: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough

p-2109.author: carol
p-2109.text: Launch notes for Atlas 1.0, written by the people who did the work: http://eng.northstar.example/posts/shipping-atlas

p-2110.author: quarks
p-2110.text: The Verge piece on Atlas is unusually good on the enforcement part, which is the only part that matters: http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism

p-2111.author: alice
p-2111.text: Cross-posting from the blog: what I learned shipping Atlas, including the bug we decided to keep. http://alicechen.dev/posts/what-i-learned-shipping-atlas

p-2112.author: praman
p-2112.text: The paragraph about deleting your own abstraction eighteen months later is worth the whole post.

messages.text: Did you ever move off mastodon.social? I still have you here and on the old instance.
Still here. Bob is the one who moved to hachyderm and then told nobody for a month.
